corrections: Separated transformer primary and secondary cable/current/protection records
Separated 200 V quay and 440 V ship shore connections
Used copper resistance at 90 °C and explicit two-wire 24 V DC loops
Included all units in grouped consumers and declared additional PE conductors
Added six-live-core star-delta motor tails and cable-only starting scenarios

openHolds.item: Real generator/transformer/motor/cable selection and certified installation data
Prospective fault levels, breaker making/breaking duties, time-current discrimination and cable fault withstand
Generator step-load response; emergency fire-pump scenario exceeds 40 kVA continuous rating; current-only sizing is insufficient
Actual cable routes, installation/grouping, transformer regulation, unbalance and complete upstream-to-consumer voltage drop
Battery Ah/endurance, DC load inventory, 105/24 V emergency converters and independent transition lighting
Emergency duration against vessel-specific flag/class requirements; a 60 L/15 h claim lacks fuel-consumption evidence
Motor six-terminal compatibility, star torque/acceleration, transition inrush and vendor packaged-equipment starting currents
Switchboard construction, earthing/insulation monitoring, shore isolation, EMC and factory/onboard acceptance testing
Mechanical ventilation duty and fan curves; fan motor kW does not prove airflow
Navigation-light dedicated circuits, panel indications, changeover and lamp-voltage requirements; general feeder-drop budget is not navigation-light approval
